question: The playbook targets Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+, but the highest supported upgrade versions are Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x. The plan currently targets Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.x. Should we proceed with these supported versions, or do you require Java 25 / Spring Boot 4.0+ (which would need custom handling)?

The playbook requires migrating RestTemplate to ServiceMesh SDK (com.acme.mesh.ServiceMesh), SLF4J to InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger), and exception-based flow control to Result<T> (com.acme.commons.Result). These are custom library migrations with no matching automation skills. Should these be added as additional manual migration tasks in the plan?

The playbook specifies container base images using Java 25 (mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu and :25-distroless). Since the plan targets Java 21, it uses Java 21 container images instead. Should the container images align with Java 21 or Java 25?
